notes.title: Demonbyte Phase 2: Echoes of Mayhem
notes.content:
[h1]Demonbyte Phase 2: [i]Echoes of Mayhem[/i] – Patch Notes[/h1][h2]Major Gameplay Changes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Removed Crosshair:[/b] To bring Demonbyte closer to its retro [i]boomer shooter[/i] roots, we’ve removed the crosshair. This change makes the gameplay more challenging and immersive, staying true to the classic FPS feel.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Weapon Balance Updates[/h2][list][*][p][b]Shotgun:[/b] Damage increased from [b]160 → 200[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Assault Rifle 47:[/b] Damage increased from [b]66 → 89[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Demonbeam Gun Ammo:[/b] Fixed an issue where ammo pickups only granted 1 charge. They now correctly provide a full 100-charge battery.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Collision Issues:[/b] Addressed several cases where monsters could clip through walls or shoot the player through invisible surfaces. (Further testing and fixes are ongoing.)[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h1]New Content: [i]Echoes of Mayhem[/i][/h1][p]This Weapon wasn’t originally on our roadmap—but we loved how it turned out and wanted to surprise you![/p][list][*][p][b]New Weapon – Scythe:[/b] A powerful melee weapon with the highest damage in the game so far. Its slower attack speed keeps it balanced within the arsenal.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Cutscenes:[/b] Additional story and satire cutscenes have been added (though we’re still behind schedule here).[/p][/*][*][p][b]8 New Enemy Types:[/b] Expect fresh challenges and gameplay shakeups—you’ll discover them as you explore![/p][/*][*][p][b]5 Brand-New Levels:[/b] With these additions, Demonbyte now features [b]20 total levels[/b], fulfilling our Phase 2 milestone.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Expanded Voice Parody Moments:[/b] More humorous voice lines have been sprinkled in, with plans to expand this even further in future updates.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Text-Based Parody Additions:[/b] A few new tongue-in-cheek moments added throughout the game.[/p][/*][/list][quote][p][i]Note:[/i] The planned “Secret Routes to Unlock Early Weapons” feature has been moved to a future update. Stay tuned![/p][/quote][hr][/hr][h1]What’s Next After Phase 2[/h1][p]Reaching Phase 2 marks a big milestone, and here’s what’s ahead:[/p][list][*][p][b]Engine Upgrade Testing:[/b] We’ll begin testing Demonbyte on the newest version of our engine. This update promises better stability, performance improvements, and new features.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Future Updates (if stable):[/b][/p][list][*][p]More parody voice lines.[/p][/*][*][p]Additional secret areas and puzzles to discover.[/p][/*][*][p]Potential “puzzle-style” secrets (complete tasks to unlock powerful weapons early).[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]Once this work is complete, we’ll shift focus toward [b]Phase 3[/b] content. For details on Phase 3, check our previously posted roadmap.[/p][hr][/hr][h1]Stay Connected[/h1][p]For more updates, discussions, and to share your feedback, you can find us here:[/p][list][*][p][b]Steam Discussions Forum[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Official Discord:[/b] [url="https://discord.gg/4vvJpVPKEB"]Join Here[/url][/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you all for your continued support as we shape Demonbyte into something truly special.[/p][p][b]– Huskey & Could Care Less Studios[/b]
CEO[/p]

notes.title: ⚙️ Engine Upgrade + Compatibility Update
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]We’re excited to announce that [i]Demonbyte[/i] has been [b]successfully ported to the newest version of the engine we use[/b]! This wasn’t just a routine upgrade—it’s packed with long-requested features, bug fixes, performance enhancements, and improvements that many players (and fellow devs from other engine-built games) have been asking for.[/p][p]While this patch doesn’t include [i]new content[/i], it lays the groundwork for a much smoother and more customizable experience moving forward. Here’s what’s changed:[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🚀 Major Engine Features Now Live in [i]Demonbyte[/i][/h3][list][*][p][b]Instant Resolution Switching[/b] — No more needing to restart the game just to apply resolution changes. Change it, and it sticks immediately. 🎉[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mouse Invert Options (X/Y)[/b] — For the rare few who like their controls spicy, we now support full mouse X and Y inversion options.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Mouse Movement[/b] — Mouse input is now much more consistent and uses raw input for smoother camera control.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🧱 General Fixes & Polishes[/h3][list][*][p][b]Company Splash Screen Fixed[/b] — A minor issue, but it bugged a few of you (and us), so we knocked it out while we were under the hood.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Menu GUI Text Color Changed[/b] — Swapped the harsh yellow text back to [b]white[/b] for improved readability and accessibility.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🛠 Compatibility & Save Support[/h3][list][*][p]All saves made in [b]previous versions[/b] should be fully compatible.[/p][/*][*][p]Broken/crashing saves should now [b]load properly[/b] without crashing.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]✨ Additional Engine Enhancements[/h3][list][*][p]Per-map light baking into vertex colors (for performance with dense lighting).[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded keybind support (some bindings now properly save and persist).[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]⚙️ Performance Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Faster entity collision/movement[/p][/*][*][p]Better handling of weapon sprites[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized decals, particles, and skyboxes[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced FPS drops[/p][/*][*][p]Better performance for sequences and logic[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🧯 Massive Bug Squash[/h3][p]This engine update comes with [b]dozens of bug fixes[/b], including:[/p][list][*][p]Weapon flickering with multiple lights[/p][/*][*][p]Resolution scaling/rendering issues[/p][/*][*][p]Projectiles phasing through enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Crash fixes related to saving, loading, models, and particles[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes for improperly saved scripted light/weapon settings[/p][/*][*][p]Muzzleflash, draw/holster, and weapon state syncing[/p][/*][*][p]Transparent particle rendering problems[/p][/*][*][p]Dozens of crash scenarios now handled gracefully[/p][/*][/list][p]For the full list of tech-side fixes (and there’s a lot), join our Discord![/p][hr][/hr][h3]💬 Final Notes from [i]Could Care Less[/i][/h3][p]This update wasn’t about new content—it was about [b]setting the foundation[/b]. Future patches will now benefit from a more stable, powerful, and player-friendly engine.[/p][p]As always, thanks for playing [i]Demonbyte[/i]. Your support keeps the chaos flowing.[/p][p]— [i]The Could Care Less Dev Team[/i][/p]

notes.title: 🔥 Demonbyte – Phase 1 Major Update: Foundations of Chaos 🔥
notes.content:
[p]Hey Slayers,[/p][p]Phase 1 of our [i]Demonbyte[/i] roadmap is here—and it’s a big one. We’ve been hard at work pushing new content, patching up bugs, and adding in a few chaotic surprises to keep things spicy. This marks a major step forward in our Early Access journey, and we’re excited to finally bring you the [b]Foundations of Chaos[/b] update![/p][p]As promised, we’ve delivered 3+ new weapons in this phase. In fact, we added a fourth because... well, we [i]could care less[/i] about limits when chaos is involved.[/p][p][b]🆕 New Weapons Added:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Sword & Shield[/b] – Get defensive and bash demons up close.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Crossbow[/b] – Silent, deadly, and built for those who like precision.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dinosaur Egg[/b] [i](Easter Egg Weapon)[/i] – Yes, you read that right. Find it, throw it, splat it![/p][/*][*][p][b]DemonBeemGun[/b] – It hums, it beams, it melts. Enough said.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🌍 5 New Levels:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Phase 1 promised 5 levels, and we delivered—bringing the total count to [b]15 levels[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Level 11[/b] is now fully finished (it used to cut off midway—no more!).[/p][/*][*][p]These levels are packed with traps, ambushes, and all the demon-slaying mayhem you've come to expect.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]👹 New Boss: The Demonlord[/b][/p][list][*][p]It’s time to face a new nightmare. Prepare for a climactic fight with the [b]Demonlord[/b], our most chaotic boss yet.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🎬 New Cutscenes & Story Moments:[/b][/p][list][*][p]A brand-new story cutscene has been added to expand the lore.[/p][/*][*][p]Multiple mini-cutscenes added for immersion and narrative flavor.[/p][/*][*][p][b]4 new parody voiceovers[/b] to give you that signature [i]Demonbyte[/i] humor.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]🕵️ Secret Content:[/b][/p][list][*][p]A new [b]parody Easter egg[/b] has been hidden inside one of the levels. If you know, you know. 😉[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🛠️ Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed various wall glitches where players could get stuck.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved issues with monsters phasing into walls (this may still require future polish).[/p][/*][*][p]Player no longer spawns facing the wall in Level 7. (You’re welcome.)[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🎁 Surprise Reveal![/h3][p]We’ve tucked a [b]very special surprise[/b] into this update. It's not a weapon, it's not a spoof—it’s something [i]much bigger[/i] and more meta than that. Play the game, explore a bit, and you might just stumble upon an [b]announcement[/b] from [i]Could Care Less[/i] that changes what’s coming next…[/p][hr][/hr][p]Thanks for sticking with us through Early Access! We’re building [i]Demonbyte[/i] with passion, chaos, and the help of our awesome community. This Phase 1 update lays down the foundation—but we’ve only just begun.[/p][p]Stay tuned. Stay chaotic.
— [i]The Could Care Less Team[/i] 🧨[/p]
